Select exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978). Require canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the provenance-rich join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures (INNER JOIN) -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL1978, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
